question: Who is the author of the book titled 'Fearless Governance'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kiran Bedi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kiran Bedi** is the author of the book titled** 'Fearless Governance'.**
 
• She is a retired **Indian Police Service officer** and **social activist** who has authored several books.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amitav Ghosh** is a renowned **Indian author **who has written several award-winning books such as **'The Shadow Lines' and 'The Great Derangement'.**
 
• **Anuj Dhar **is an Indian author and former journalist who has written extensively on the **Indian intelligence agencies and their activities.**
 
• **Anirudh Suri **is an Indian entrepreneur and author who has written a book titled **'The Great Disruption'.**
